name: Masons
overview: Scripture reveals that true foundation and guidance come from God and Christ, the ultimate Creator and cornerstone. While human builders may reject the stone, God appoints it as the chief cornerstone, symbolizing Christ's essential role in salvation and life. Believers are called to recognize God's sovereignty in all things, including their senses and vows, and to follow Jesus, who is the light, the way, the truth, and the life, leading them away from darkness and into fellowship with the Father.
